messages.subject: Error when applying a different buffer per session in a multi-session model
parts:
Hi everyone!

I'm hoping to get some assistance with giving each session a different buffer size in a multi-session SECR model in R Studio please. I am trying to work out the density of Short-eared possums (Trichosurus caninus) in different habitat types. Each session is either dry-sclerophyll, wet-sclerophyll or rainforest habitat.

R Script:
> setwd("C:/Users/lmcra/OneDrive/Desktop/Career/Uni/Honours/Data/Combined")
> library(secr)
> PossumCH <- read.capthist('CHistory_FINAL.txt', c("session1.txt", "session2_2.txt", "session3.txt", "session4_2.txt", "session5.txt", "Session11.txt", "Session12.txt", "Session13.txt"), detector = "multi")

Detections 63 10 51  0  0 13  0  0
Animals    17  5 18  0  0  9  0  0
Detectors  13 13 13 14 13 10 13 10
> masks <- list(make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session1.txt"]]), buffer = 270, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session2_2.txt"]]), buffer = 280, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session3.txt"]]), buffer = 240, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session4_2.txt"]]), buffer = 275, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session5.txt"]]), buffer = 275, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["Session11.txt"]]), buffer = 240, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["Session12.txt"]]), buffer = 240, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["Session13.txt"]]), buffer = 240, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'))
Error in make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session1.txt"]]), buffer = 270, nx = 32,  : 
  require spacing for rectangular mask

I then added in "spacing = 30" to each mask (my traps are spaced about 80-110m (depending on the session)). This resolved the initial error but I now have another error when I try to fit the model. R Script:

> masks <- list(make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session1.txt"]]), buffer = 270, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session2_2.txt"]]), buffer = 280, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session3.txt"]]), buffer = 240, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session4_2.txt"]]), buffer = 275, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["session5.txt"]]), buffer = 275, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["Session11.txt"]]), buffer = 240, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["Session12.txt"]]), buffer = 240, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'), 
+               make.mask(traps(PossumCH[["Session13.txt"]]), buffer = 240, spacing = 30, nx = 32, type = 'trapbuffer'))
> covariatesource <- read.mask('HabitatCovariates_8S.txt')
> masks <- addCovariates(masks, covariatesource)
> sessionhab <- data.frame(habitat = c('Rainforest', 'WetSclerophyll', 'Rainforest', 'DrySclerophyll', 'DrySclerophyll', 'Rainforest', 'DrySclerophyll', 'DrySclerophyll'))
> fit <- secr.fit(PossumCH, mask = masks, detectfn = 'HN', model = D~habitat, sessioncov = sessionhab, trace = FALSE, verify = FALSE)
Error in start[parindx[[i]][1]] <- getdefault(names(parindx)[i]) : 
  replacement has length zero
In addition: Warning message:
In autoini(ch, msk, binomN = tempbinomN, adjustg0 = details$binomN[1] ==  :
  'autoini' failed to find g0; setting initial g0 = 0.1

I'm really not sure how to get past this error or what it means so any assistance is greatly appreciated! I've attached all of my data in case it is needed.

Cheers,
Lachlan McRae

messages.subject: Re: Error when applying a different buffer per session in a multi-session model
parts:
There is absolutely no need to specify different buffer widths - just use the largest (perhaps go to 300 m).
The argument 'nx' is ignored when you specify spacing.

You seem to have stumbled on a problem with lists of masks. I'm not sure yet if this is a bug, but in the meantime I think this works -

masks <- make.mask(traps(PossumCH), buffer = 280, spacing = 30, type = 'trapbuffer')

covariatesource <- read.mask('HabitatCovariates_8S.txt')
masks <- addCovariates(masks, covariatesource)
sessionhab <- data.frame(habitat = c('Rainforest', 'WetSclerophyll', 'Rainforest', 'DrySclerophyll', 'DrySclerophyll', 'Rainforest', 'DrySclerophyll', 'DrySclerophyll'))
fit <- secr.fit(PossumCH, mask = masks, detectfn = 'HN', model = D~habitat, sessioncov = sessionhab, trace = FALSE, verify = FALSE)
